about: Requests about being put somewhere, in a blind person's casual words, and requests that only look like it. Written on 2026-11-19 before anything was run on them, after claw/placing.py was written, by the same hand: a measure of plain code on wordings it was not tuned on, not of a model. expect: the jobs that are right for the request as one part. Never take a request of this set into known.json or a pattern's test.
